entries.text: Well, some call it the Phantom Death, 'cause that's what it is.  You can't see it, you can't hear it, you can't even smell it.  It basically builds up in your system.  You never feel it until it's too late.  The more trips you make to Hot Spots, the more it builds up and it will never leave your system.  Ever.  The Rads just keep building up.  Well... unless you can get a hold of some Rad-Away.
